rules: Forward observations at or after a protocol boundary must never be used to retune that same protocol version.
Every directional observation must carry the frozen protocol/candidate digest used at decision time.
Freeze a SHA-256 of the exact as-observed source/feature/HTF/next-open evidence at decision time; retrospective vendor bar revisions may not replace it.
Missing price intervals are censored; they are never interpolated into a win or loss.
Same-bar stop-and-target ambiguity is scored stop-first.
No record produced by this registry has broker, quantity, approval, notification, account or live-strategy authority.
